title: Your Claude Cowork and Skills: Set Up Once, Then a New Skill a Week

sections.label: 1 - SET UP CLAUDE COWORK
sections.note: Claude on your own computer, working in one folder you choose, with your email, calendar and files connected. One sitting, and you can use it the same day.

sections.label: 2 - YOUR FIRST SKILLS
sections.note: A skill is a set of saved instructions Claude reuses, so you ask once and get the same quality every time. We start with the four jobs you do every week and test each one on your real listings and leads.

sections.label: 3 - ADD A SKILL A WEEK, ONGOING
sections.note: You said ongoing, so the list keeps growing. Each week you tell me the task that ate your time and it becomes the next skill.
